title: Automatic Sweep: How Nightly Fund Transfers Work
summary: Explains how Automatic Sweep nightly fund transfers run at 11:00 PM: it evaluates your checking balance, transfers excess above your configured target minimum to your linked savings as a consolidated sweep, and (if Reverse sweeps = Yes) can move funds back if checking falls below the target. Also covers posting order and next-cycle adjustments.
